audit.whatIsWrong: All seven level-chart rows disagreed across layers. Full-layer phases[].side read Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[] read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Naafiri/Naafiri/Orianna. Every row on the page rendered two answers.
audit.why: The content layer matches the packet levelChart and is the one grounded in the kit: at level 1 Naafiri has no Eviscerate and weak packmates, so Orianna's placed ball wins; levels 2-5 are a genuine trade fight between 900-range Darkin Daggers bleed and Q-W; level 6 and first item are hers because Hounds' Pursuit is a 900-range lock-on dash with a shielding recast against an immobile mage; two-plus items go to Orianna because a five-man Shockwave outscales single-target assassination.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content values for all seven rows with ratings 7/5/5/5/3/3/7, and every why rewritten in the same proposal to argue the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text credited Hounds' Pursuit with adding packmates, damage and healing, and told you to shield the instant she W-dashes.
audit.why: Riot's R text: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, she can recast once, and the second cast grants a shield - no healing and no extra packmates. Packmates come from The Call of the Pack (W), which is a 26s untargetability window, not a dash. The dash you must shield is Eviscerate (E, 450 range, 11/10/9/8/7s) or the R itself.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten around the 900-range lock-on and the shielding recast, with the shield timed to the dash itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and the packet recorded zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: The three numbers that decide every step-up are Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80 at 900 range, Eviscerate 11/10/9/8/7 at 450 range, and The Call of the Pack 26/24/22/20/18. Eviscerate is both her gap-close and her escape, so its downtime is the only safe window to walk forward.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0..2] and dontsFull[0..2] now carry those numbers and a wait-for-X-before-Y sequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-three misgendering findings: Naafiri called he/his across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, six phases whys, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, five dos/donts fields and six report entries. Also a fabricated ability name: content.mid wrote "Darkin Dagger poke".
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists naafiri as female. Her Q is Darkin Daggers, plural - she hurls up to two daggers, which is why the plural matters.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her; content.mid corrected to Darkin Daggers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions proposes an anti-heal line saying Naafiri sustains through chip via Eviscerate, and report[8].t told you to buy anti-heal into "his" sustain.
audit.why: Riot's E text says the dash recalls her packmates and fully heals THEM - the healing lands on packmates, not on Naafiri. Grievous Wounds on Naafiri is not what that text supports. What is supported is that killing packmates with W is undone by one Eviscerate cast.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says to clear packmates with W rather than asserting an anti-heal timing the kit does not give. No anti-heal claim written.

notes: All seven chart rows disagreed across layers here - the worst case in this slice. Full layer was moved onto the content layer, which the packet levelChart corroborates. No paired win[N] edits are proposed because win[N] already holds the correct value on disk. Fabricated ability name fixed: content.mid said "Darkin Dagger", the Q is Darkin Daggers. Two kit-text errors corrected in spikes[1].text: Hounds' Pursuit does not add packmates or healing (the recast grants a shield), and The Call of the Pack is not a dash. The brief's needs-antiheal interaction was NOT written to the page - Riot's E text heals her packmates, not Naafiri, so a Grievous Wounds timing claim is not supported; see unverified. report[3].t, report[4].t, report[1].t and report[11].t also carry misgendered pronouns; report[1] and report[11] mirror winCon and the donts titles this proposal already rewrites, and report[3]/report[4] mirror breakdown.trading and breakdown.wave, so they were left rather than spending report scope on four duplicate rewrites. If the applier does not propagate, they need a follow-up pronoun pass.
